shortDescription: Information module for Wireless Controllers Ssid Details

options.name: adminStatus
options.description: AdminStatus query parameter. Utilize this query parameter to obtain the administrative status. A 'true' value signifies that the admin status of the SSID is enabled, while a 'false' value indicates that the admin status of the SSID is disabled.

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page. Default is 500 if not specified. Maximum allowed limit is 500.

options.name: managed
options.description: Managed query parameter. If value is 'true' means SSIDs are configured through design.If the value is 'false' means out of band configuration from the Wireless Controller.

options.name: networkDeviceId
options.description: NetworkDeviceId path parameter. Obtain the network device ID value by using the API call GET /dna/intent/api/v1/network-device/ip-address/${ipAddress}.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1.

options.name: ssidName
options.description: SsidName query parameter. Employ this query parameter to obtain the details of the SSID corresponding to the provided SSID name.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
